claim_text: 來源機構：Frontiers in Psychology（Frontiers）；資料標題：AI leadership readiness profiles and competence gaps among school leaders during digital transformation: a comparative study of China and Kazakhstan；來源刊登日：2026-11-20。作者摘要報告：研究探討中國與哈薩克學校領導者的 AI 領導準備度，涵蓋情境理解、教學價值、風險關切、數位領導自我效能、組織支持、領導層對導入的支持、實施準備度與能力落差；以 763 名學校領導者（中國 389、哈薩克 374）的跨國問卷進行分析；作者指出，正面的教學評價常與中等的學校層級準備並存，倫理與風險治理、教師發展與內容品質稽核是專業學習的優先項目。（AI 輔助摘要，未經真人逐則審稿；請參閱原文。）
source_title: AI leadership readiness profiles and competence gaps among school leaders during digital transformation: a comparative study of China and Kazakhstan
title_zh: 數位轉型中學校領導者的 AI 領導準備度剖面與能力落差：中國與哈薩克比較研究

original_excerpt: This cross-national study examined AI leadership readiness in China and Kazakhstan, focusing on scenario understanding, instructional value, risk concern, digital leadership self-efficacy, organizational support, leadership support for adoption, implementation readiness, and competence gaps. … We analyzed a cross-national quantitative survey of 763 school leaders (China n = 389; Kazakhstan n = 374) using reliability analysis, measurement invariance testing, latent profile analysis, standardized recursive path modeling, and importance–competence gap analysis. … Positive instructional appraisals frequently coexisted with moderate school-level preparation. … Ethics and risk governance, teacher development, and content quality audit emerged as the leading priorities for professional learning.

summary_evidence_spans: This cross-national study examined AI leadership readiness in China and Kazakhstan, focusing on scenario understanding, instructional value, risk concern, digital leadership self-efficacy, organizational support, leadership support for adoption, implementation readiness, and competence gaps.

We analyzed a cross-national quantitative survey of 763 school leaders (China n = 389; Kazakhstan n = 374) using reliability analysis, measurement invariance testing, latent profile analysis, standardized recursive path modeling, and importance–competence gap analysis.
Positive instructional appraisals frequently coexisted with moderate school-level preparation.
Ethics and risk governance, teacher development, and content quality audit emerged as the leading priorities for professional learning.

claim_text: 來源機構：Early Education and Development（Taylor & Francis）；資料標題：Understanding Early Childhood Educators’ Acceptance of AI: Integrating AI Literacy into Technology Acceptance Model 3 and Theory of Planned Behavior；來源刊登日：2026-11-16。作者摘要報告：研究整合科技接受模式 3（TAM3）與計畫行為理論（TPB）的部分構念並納入 AI 素養，建構並檢驗解釋幼教工作者使用 AI 行為意圖的模型；以偏最小平方結構方程模型分析 1,696 名中國幼教工作者的問卷資料，模型可解釋行為意圖 89.2% 的變異；作者表示此模型為理解中國幼教工作者在工作中採用 AI 的意圖提供框架。（AI 輔助摘要，未經真人逐則審稿；請參閱原文。）
source_title: Understanding Early Childhood Educators’ Acceptance of AI: Integrating AI Literacy into Technology Acceptance Model 3 and Theory of Planned Behavior
title_zh: 理解幼教工作者對 AI 的接受度：將 AI 素養整合進科技接受模式 3 與計畫行為理論

original_excerpt: This study develops and tests an integrated model that draws on selected constructs from the Technology Acceptance Model 3 (TAM3) and the Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB) and incorporates artificial intelligence (AI) literacy to explain early childhood education (ECE) educators’ behavioral intention to use AI. … Using partial least squares structural equation modeling to analyze survey data from 1,696 Chinese ECE educators (97.9% female), who were recruited primarily from the public sector, the integrated model accounted for 89.2% of the variance in behavioral intention. … Theoretically, the integrated model offers a coherent framework for understanding Chinese ECE educators’ intentions to adopt AI at work.
interpretation_note: 轉述作者摘要的研究目的、理論架構、樣本、分析方法、模型解釋量與作者對模型用途的說明；各因子的效果大小與方向、AI 焦慮的結果與實務建議不寫入，不寫因果。

summary_evidence_spans: This study develops and tests an integrated model that draws on selected constructs from the Technology Acceptance Model 3 (TAM3) and the Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB) and incorporates artificial intelligence (AI) literacy to explain early childhood education (ECE) educators’ behavioral intention to use AI.

Using partial least squares structural equation modeling to analyze survey data from 1,696 Chinese ECE educators (97.9% female), who were recruited primarily from the public sector, the integrated model accounted for 89.2% of the variance in behavioral intention.
Theoretically, the integrated model offers a coherent framework for understanding Chinese ECE educators’ intentions to adopt AI at work.
